title: ET - Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: 4 Sept 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1739622

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**ET - Senior DevOps Engineer**

  

**The opportunity**

  

The selected candidate will:

* Have strong design and hands on development experience on enterprise software applications for both on prem and cloud using primarily Microsoft technologies.
* Leads the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for a large or more complex project, using advanced technical capabilities.
* Takes accountability for the design, development, delivery and maintenance of solutions or infrastructure, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards.
* Fully understands business and user requirements and ensures design specifications meet the requirements from a business and technical perspective.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Engineer and automate platform solutions to meet and exceed expectations of Product Manager
* Proactively evolve and apply DevSecOps methodologies, standards and leading practices
* Apply modern development standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, security standards, usability design standards, as appropriate.
* Ensure quality through use of manual and automated controls
* Identify, communicate and mitigate Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions throughout full lifecycle
* Using critical thinking, consider the art of the possible, compare various options based on feasibility and impact, propose impactful plans and roadmaps that balance tactical and strategic needs
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
* Manage Azure resources, subscriptions, networking, storage, and compute services.
* Collaborate with development teams to streamline application deployment and release processes.
* Implement and maintain source control and branching strategies using Git.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Ensure security, compliance, and governance standards are followed throughout the DevOps lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot deployment, infrastructure, and performance-related issues.
* Support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Maintain technical documentation and promote DevOps best practices across teams.

  

**Required Skills**

  

* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure services.
* Hands-on expertise with Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, Azure Repos, and Azure Boards.
* Experience in CI/CD implementation and automation.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Knowledge of Git and branching strategies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, or Bicep).
* Understanding of Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also**

  

* Source control Management (git)
* Azure cloud
* ARM Templates
* Scripting (PowerShell or Python)
* Azure DevOps Pipelines
* Agile methodology
* Containers
* Ansible
* AZ400 Certified Preferred

  

**What we look for**

  

* A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition and passion

  

**What we offer you**

  

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: DevOps Engineer – Part-Time
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **DevOps Engineer** with a minimum of **1 year of hands\-on experience** in cloud infrastructure, server administration, automation, and deployment. The ideal candidate should have practical experience with **AWS, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, Git, and Jenkins** and be comfortable managing development and production environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Manage and maintain **Linux\-based servers and cloud infrastructure**.

● Deploy and maintain applications across **staging and production environments**.

● Configure and manage **AWS services**, including EC2, S3, RDS, Route 53, IAM, VPC, ELB, and related resources.

● Set up and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.

● Manage **Docker containers** and containerized applications.

● Support application deployment and troubleshooting across development and production environments.

● Automate server configuration and deployment

● Manage **DNS, SSL certificates, security groups, backups, AMIs, snapshots, and storage volumes**.

● Monitor servers and applications.

● Assist with **Kubernetes** deployments and container orchestration.

● Troubleshoot server, application, networking, and deployment\-related issues.

● Work closely with developers to ensure smooth and reliable application releases.

● Maintain proper documentation of infrastructure, configurations, and deployment procedures.

**Required Skills**

● Minimum **1 year of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or System Administration**.

● Strong knowledge of **Linux/RHEL administration**.

● Hands\-on experience with **AWS Cloud**.

● Good knowledge of **Docker and containerization**.

● Experience with **Jenkins / GitHub Actions / CI\-CD pipelines**.

● Working knowledge of **Git**.

● Basic working knowledge of **Kubernetes**.

● Understanding of **AWS networking, VPC, DNS, Route 53, Security Groups, and ELB**.

● Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

**Experience:** Minimum 1 year  
**Job Type:** Part\-Time  
**Location:** Kochi / Hybrid

Candidates with practical experience in AWS, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and CI/CD are encouraged to apply

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Vyttila, Kochi, Kerala

title: DevOps Trainer
description:
DevOps Trainer / FacultyPosition

**Designation:** DevOps Trainer / Faculty  
**Department:** Technical / Training  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** SDC Networks, Kochi  
**Reporting To:** Technical Head / Academic Head

Call: \+91 8089227007

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and passionate **DevOps Trainer / Faculty** to deliver high\-quality technical training to students and professionals. The trainer will be responsible for teaching DevOps concepts, tools, methodologies, and real\-world implementation through practical sessions, projects, and hands\-on lab exercises.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to simplify complex DevOps concepts for learners with different levels of technical experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct classroom and online training sessions on **DevOps and related technologies**.
* Develop and deliver structured training sessions according to the institute's curriculum.
* Provide extensive **hands\-on practical training** and real\-world demonstrations.
* Prepare lesson plans, presentations, lab exercises, assignments, assessments, and mock tests.
* Guide students in developing **industry\-oriented DevOps projects**.
* Monitor student performance and provide technical guidance and feedback.
* Troubleshoot student issues during practical and lab sessions.
* Keep course content updated with current DevOps tools, practices, and industry trends.
* Conduct practical assessments, technical evaluations, and project reviews.
* Support students in preparing for relevant **DevOps and cloud certifications**.
* Mentor students on career opportunities, technical interviews, and industry expectations.
* Maintain proper records of attendance, assessments, student progress, and course completion.
* Coordinate with the Academic/Technical team to improve training quality.
* Participate in seminars, workshops, webinars, and technical events conducted by the institute.

Technical Skills Required

The candidate should have practical knowledge of several of the following:

**DevOps \& CI/CD**

* DevOps fundamentals and lifecycle
* CI/CD concepts and implementation
* Jenkins
* Git / GitHub / GitLab
* Maven / Gradle
* SonarQube
* Artifact repositories

**Containerization \& Orchestration**

* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Helm
* Container networking and security

**Cloud Platforms**

* AWS / Microsoft Azure / Google Cloud
* Cloud infrastructure and deployment
* IAM and cloud security fundamentals
* Compute, storage, networking and monitoring services

**Infrastructure as Code \& Automation**

* Terraform
* Ansible
* Configuration management
* Infrastructure automation

**Linux \& Scripting**

* Linux administration
* Bash/Shell scripting
* Python fundamentals for automation

**Monitoring \& Logging**

* Prometheus
* Grafana
* ELK / OpenSearch or similar monitoring and logging tools

**Version Control**

* Git
* GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket
* Branching and merging strategies

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field**.
* Relevant professional certifications will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **2\+ years of practical experience** in DevOps, Cloud, System Administration, SRE, or related technologies.
* Previous experience as a **technical trainer/faculty** is preferred.
* Candidates with strong industry experience and excellent technical knowledge may also be considered.

Trainer Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and understandable manner.
* Strong presentation and classroom management skills.
* Ability to conduct effective hands\-on laboratory sessions.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Student\-focused approach to teaching and mentoring.
* Ability to create practical, industry\-oriented learning experiences.
* Willingness to continuously learn and upgrade technical skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Student attendance and engagement.
* Student performance in assessments and practical examinations.
* Successful completion of assigned modules within the planned schedule.
* Quality and effectiveness of practical/lab sessions.
* Student feedback and training quality.
* Successful completion of student projects.
* Student certification and placement support.
* Timely preparation of training materials, assessments, and reports.

Additional Responsibilities

* Conduct **Demo Classes / Orientation Sessions** for prospective students when required.
* Participate in technical seminars and workshops.
* Assist the institute in developing new technical courses and lab environments.
* Support placement activities through technical interview preparation and mock interviews.
* Maintain professional standards and follow institute policies and procedures.

Preferred Certifications

Certifications such as the following will be an advantage:

* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* Red Hat certifications
* Docker/Kubernetes certifications
* Relevant Linux or Cloud certifications

Salary \& Benefits

**Salary:** As per experience, technical expertise, and interview performance.

Additional benefits may include:

* Performance\-based incentives
* Professional development opportunities
* Certification support
* Opportunity to work with industry\-oriented training programs
* Career growth within the technical training department

Application Requirement

Candidates applying for the position may be required to submit:

* Updated CV/Resume
* Copies of relevant educational and professional certificates
* Details of technical experience
* **Technical PPT Presentation / Demo Class** as part of the selection process

**Selection will be based on technical expertise, practical knowledge, communication skills, presentation ability, and overall suitability for the trainer role.**

title: Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer
description:
**Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer**

**Company:** Plus UAE Group  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala, India  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 4–8 years

**About the Role**

Plus UAE Group is looking for a hands\-on **Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer** to build, manage, secure, and continuously improve our cloud infrastructure and deployment platform.

This is not a monitoring\-only or ticket\-based DevOps role.

You will take ownership of the infrastructure that supports our applications, from cloud resources and containerization to CI/CD, Kubernetes, observability, security, backups, troubleshooting, and production reliability.

We are looking for someone who understands **why the infrastructure is designed a certain way**, can make sound technical decisions independently, and can build reliable systems rather than simply follow existing documentation.

**What You Will Own**

**AWS Infrastructure**

Design, deploy, configure, and maintain AWS infrastructure including:

* EC2
* EBS
* S3
* ECR
* CodeArtifact
* IPv4 and networking
* Data transfer
* CloudWatch
* IAM and access control
* Security groups and infrastructure security
* Backup and recovery

You will be responsible for understanding infrastructure dependencies, performance, availability, security, and cost.

**Kubernetes \& Containers**

* Build and maintain containerized application environments.
* Work extensively with Docker.
* Deploy and manage applications using Kubernetes.
* Configure deployments, services, ingress, secrets, configuration, storage, and resource limits.
* Troubleshoot application and cluster\-level issues.
* Manage container images through Amazon ECR.
* Establish reliable deployment and rollback procedures.

**CI/CD**

Design and maintain automated deployment pipelines using:

* Bitbucket Repositories
* Bitbucket Pipelines
* Docker
* ECR
* Kubernetes

The objective is to create a dependable path from:

**Code → Build → Test → Image → Registry → Deployment → Verification**

You will continuously improve the speed, reliability, and safety of this process.

**Infrastructure as Code**

We expect infrastructure to be reproducible rather than manually configured wherever practical.

Experience with **Terraform** or an equivalent Infrastructure\-as\-Code approach is strongly preferred.

You should be comfortable creating and maintaining infrastructure configurations that can be version\-controlled, reviewed, reproduced, and recovered.

**Monitoring \& Observability**

Build and maintain a practical observability system using:

* Prometheus
* Grafana
* Loki
* CloudWatch

You will establish meaningful monitoring for:

* Infrastructure
* Containers
* Kubernetes
* Applications
* CPU, memory, and storage
* Network behaviour
* Application errors
* Logs
* Service availability

The goal is not simply to collect metrics. The goal is to make problems visible and diagnosable.

**Security**

Take responsibility for infrastructure\-level security, including:

* AWS IAM
* Least\-privilege access
* SSH and access management
* Network security
* Secrets management
* Container security
* Kubernetes security
* Secure CI/CD pipelines
* Dependency and package security
* Secure production configuration

You should be able to identify infrastructure security risks and implement practical controls.

**Reliability \& Troubleshooting**

When something breaks, you are expected to investigate the actual root cause.

You will troubleshoot issues involving:

* AWS infrastructure
* Linux
* Networking
* DNS
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* CI/CD
* Application deployment
* Database connectivity
* Storage
* Logs
* Performance
* Resource utilization

You should be comfortable working from:

**Symptoms → Evidence → Root Cause → Corrective Action**

**AI / Document Processing Infrastructure**

Our technology environment also includes **OCR and Claude CLI\-based AI workflows**.

You will support the infrastructure required to run these workloads reliably and integrate them into the broader application and deployment environment.

You do not need to be an AI researcher. You should understand how AI and document\-processing workloads are deployed, monitored, secured, and integrated into production systems.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong Linux administration
* AWS production experience
* EC2
* EBS
* S3
* ECR
* IAM
* Networking fundamentals
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* CI/CD
* Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent
* Production troubleshooting
* Monitoring and logging
* Git
* Shell scripting

**Strongly Preferred**

* Terraform
* Prometheus
* Grafana
* Loki
* CloudWatch
* AWS networking/VPC
* Infrastructure security
* Container security
* Kubernetes troubleshooting
* Automated backups and recovery
* Cost optimization
* Python or another scripting language

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Can work independently.
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Understands production systems beyond individual tools.
* Can design infrastructure based on actual requirements.
* Can troubleshoot without guessing.
* Documents important infrastructure decisions.
* Thinks about security before deployment, not after an incident.
* Understands reliability and recovery.
* Can simplify infrastructure where unnecessary complexity exists.
* Is comfortable building systems from the ground up.
* Can explain technical decisions clearly to non\-specialist management.

**What We Don't Want**

This role is **not** for someone whose experience is primarily:

* Running preconfigured deployment scripts.
* Watching dashboards and escalating alerts.
* Creating EC2 instances from instructions.
* Following Kubernetes tutorials without production experience.
* Listing AWS/Kubernetes certifications without hands\-on capability.
* Managing infrastructure only through a GUI without understanding the underlying systems.
* Calling themselves DevOps because they have used Docker or Git.

**We value demonstrated capability over certifications and job titles.**

**Experience**

**4–8 years of relevant experience** is preferred.

However, experience will not be evaluated by years alone.

A candidate with fewer years but strong hands\-on production experience may be considered, while a candidate with many years of experience but limited ownership may not be suitable.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

**How We Evaluate Candidates**

The selection process will focus heavily on practical capability.

Candidates may be asked to explain or demonstrate scenarios such as:

* Designing an AWS environment for a frontend, backend, and database.
* Building a Docker\-based deployment workflow.
* Designing a Kubernetes deployment.
* Creating a Bitbucket CI/CD pipeline.
* Handling a failed production deployment.
* Diagnosing a Kubernetes pod that repeatedly crashes.
* Investigating high CPU or memory usage.
* Designing monitoring and alerting.
* Recovering a failed server or service.
* Securing AWS and Kubernetes access.
* Reducing unnecessary infrastructure cost.
* Explaining how they would structure Infrastructure as Code.

We are interested in **how you think and troubleshoot**, not only whether you know the terminology.

**Why Join Plus UAE Group?**

This role offers the opportunity to take genuine ownership of a growing technology platform rather than working as one small component of a large infrastructure team.

You will have the opportunity to:

* Build infrastructure from the ground up.
* Make meaningful architecture and tooling decisions.
* Work directly with AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability.
* Establish production engineering practices.
* Work across infrastructure, application deployment, security, and reliability.
* Build systems supporting real business applications and AI\-enabled workflows.

**Apply**

If you are a hands\-on infrastructure engineer who enjoys **building, solving difficult production problems, and taking ownership**, we would like to hear from you.

Please share your CV along with a brief description of the most complex production infrastructure you have personally built, managed, or troubleshot.

Pay: From ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Lead - Cloud DevOps 3
description:
**Job Title \- Cloud DevOps Lead – Specialist \- ACS SONG**

**Management Level: Level 9 \- Specialist**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must\-have skills: Cloud operations leadership; installation, configuration and management of Linux systems; public cloud administration; incident and problem management**

**Good\-to\-have skills: Terraform/CloudFormation, Docker/Kubernetes, monitoring and observability tools, scripting/automation, AI adoption and AI\-assisted operations, JIRA/Confluence**

**Experience: 5–8 years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or team\-lead role**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation**

**Job Summary**
---------------


As a Cloud DevOps Lead, you will provide technical leadership for an e\-commerce platform running across on\-premises and cloud infrastructure. You will own platform reliability, operational readiness, and technical delivery; lead the resolution of complex incidents and problems; govern production changes; and drive automation, observability, security, performance, and cost improvements. You will guide engineers, coordinate with application, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders, and act as a trusted, client\-facing technical advisor by identifying improvement opportunities and presenting clear, value\-focused proposals that strengthen reliability, efficiency, security, and cost effectiveness.

**Roles and Responsibilities**
------------------------------

* Lead day\-to\-day cloud operations and provide technical direction, task prioritization, coaching, and escalation support to the operations team.
* Build trusted client relationships through regular technical discussions, service reviews, and advisory sessions; understand business priorities and translate them into practical cloud and operational improvement opportunities.
* Develop and present evidence\-based technical improvement proposals, including the current\-state assessment, recommended solution, expected business and operational benefits, risks, effort, cost considerations, and implementation roadmap; incorporate client feedback and support decisions through execution.
* Own platform availability, reliability, performance, capacity, security, and operational readiness across on\-premises and public\-cloud environments.
* Lead major incident response, coordinate technical recovery, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure timely root\-cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Govern problem, change, release, service\-request, and configuration\-management activities in line with service\-level agreements and operational controls.
* Review system architecture, deployment designs, operational procedures, and technical changes to ensure scalability, resilience, supportability, and compliance.
* Define and improve monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, runbooks, and service health indicators to enable proactive issue detection and resolution.
* Drive automation of provisioning, deployment, maintenance, recovery, and routine support activities using infrastructure\-as\-code and scripting practices.
* Analyze operational trends, recurring incidents, capacity risks, and service metrics; maintain an improvement backlog and track actions to closure.
* Partner with application, DevOps, cloud, network, database, security, and vendor teams to resolve cross\-platform issues and deliver technical improvements.
* Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, disaster\-recovery procedures, and audit evidence; conduct knowledge\-sharing and readiness reviews.
* Support effort estimation, technical planning, resource coordination, and stakeholder reporting for operational and transformation initiatives.
* Participate in the on\-call rotation and ensure effective shift handovers, escalation paths, and operational coverage.

  

**Professional and Technical Skills**
-------------------------------------

* 5–8 years of experience in cloud or infrastructure operations, including hands\-on technical leadership of production support teams.
* Expertise in installing, configuring, patching, troubleshooting, and administering Linux and Windows systems.
* Strong experience operating services on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including compute, network, storage, identity, backup, and monitoring services.
* Strong knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, capacity planning, performance tuning, security hardening, access controls, and cloud cost optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or equivalent tools.
* Experience administering and troubleshooting Java application servers such as JBoss, WebLogic, or Tomcat, including application, system, and garbage\-collection log analysis.
* Practical experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and automation using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Working knowledge of containers and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift.
* Experience with logging and messaging platforms such as Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana and Kafka.
* Good working knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis.
* Strong understanding of IT service\-management practices covering incident, problem, change, release, configuration, knowledge, and service\-level management.
* Demonstrated ability to lead troubleshooting, make sound technical decisions under pressure, mentor engineers, conduct technical reviews, and manage escalations.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting skills, including requirements discovery, facilitation of technical workshops and service reviews, management of expectations, and confident presentation of technical improvement proposals to client stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues, risks, and recommendations for business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience developing automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, quality, and consistency.
* Ability to evaluate and adopt enterprise\-approved AI tools for cloud operations, including AI\-assisted monitoring, incident analysis, knowledge management, automation, and continuous improvement, while following security, privacy, and responsible\-AI standards.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or equivalent service\-management and collaboration tools.
* Experience working in Agile, DevOps, and site reliability engineering environments.
* Relevant cloud, Linux, Kubernetes, ITIL, or DevOps certifications are an advantage.
* A customer\-focused, process\-driven approach with strong ownership, analytical thinking, and continuous\-improvement skills.

**Additional Information**

About Our Company \| Accenture (do not remove the hyperlink)
